top_story.headline: No new FEC compliance filings surfaced since the last edition
top_story.dek: All 244 RFAI and Form 99 filings in the three-day window were already reported in earlier editions, and no new voided or negative transactions met the threshold.
paragraphs: The scripts found 244 Request for Additional Information (RFAI) and Form 99 filings received since October 13, 2026, but every one was already covered in a prior edition, so this edition has no new filings to list. No red-flag keyword hits and no new voided or negative transactions of $10,000 or more turned up either.

The only new item in the extras is outside money: one independent expenditure of $67,030 opposing Kelly Kirschner in Florida's 16th Congressional District, reported by Conservatives For American Excellence Inc. It is detailed in the Outside Money section below.

sections.headline: $67,030 in new independent expenditures
paragraphs: 1 new independent expenditures of $50K or more, $67,030 in all. Largest target: Kelly Kirschner (oppose, $67,030).

blocks.text: Independent expenditures of $50K+ reported since 10/13/2026 (24/48-hour notices plus regular reports), counting only items not shown in an earlier edition. A shared vendor is a coordination-risk flag, not proof: FEC rules allow common vendors behind a firewall. Generic platforms (ActBlue, Google, postal, banks, broadcasters) are excluded.

footer.coverage_window: FEC RFAI (form FRQ) and Form 99 filings received October 13, 2026 onward, checked as of the Friday, October 16, 2026 PM edition.
footer.sources: FEC filings API; FEC Schedule A/B itemized transactions.
